featured_reviews.name: Parag Jalgaonkar
featured_reviews.review_text:
​I have had a consistently frustrating experience trying to get in touch with Gold's Gym at Breach Candy to inquire about a membership. For weeks, I've tried to contact them multiple times a day through both phone calls and WhatsApp, but there has been absolutely no response. It's incredibly unprofessional and makes me question their commitment to customer service before even stepping foot inside.
​Furthermore, I have noticed that the gym appears to be closed half the time, which is a significant concern. The inconsistent operating hours are a major red flag, as they suggest an unreliable service that would make it difficult for any potential member to maintain a regular workout schedule.

featured_reviews.name: Roshini Kotecha
featured_reviews.review_text: The studio is lovely, extremely clean and the changing rooms have showers with deodorant, mouthwash etc. Front of desk were lovely which slightly made up for me having to physically go there in person to book a class (international cards don’t work on website fyi). featured_reviews.name: Kanika Sharma Goenka
featured_reviews.review_text:
Worst experience ever - I was refused to be let in to class despite coming from very far away and despite a terrible thunderstorm in the city which caused water to pool up everywhere. I told the reception that I was a new breastfeeding mother who had managed to reach the class 12 minutes late after feeding my baby and dropping a second to school. Still, the reception was totally unrelenting - telling me there was nothing they could do. Rules are great, but surely letting in a person 2 mins later (in view of the exigencies described) would not cause any harm! Rules over humanity, is evidently what they practice here! NEVER AGAIN! Soleus is a far far better bet - especially if you need some grace!
As I’m scrolling reviews I see multiple reviews of the awful customer service - wish I’d seen it earlier!

featured_reviews.name: Rishabh Arora
featured_reviews.review_text:
Even 1 star is too much.

Worst Gym - I have ever joined in my life.
There is a lot that needs to be spoken so I will share the following points.

I had joined this gym early 2025 even though I only went for a month I had medical issues I stopped going.

During that month I observed following things -

Most unhygienic shower room
No mats outside washroom
No cleaning shower rooms.

If you're a beginner and you think you will joing and any trainer is going to help you forget about that. I don't blame them considering the fact how it's maintained I feel bad for trainers.

Even though I never asked fortunately I never needed a trainer.

I remember complaining about keeping the mats ( which is barely of any cost ) to keep outside steam room and washrooms no change.

I stopped going to gym after a month now after 6 months I went for the first time expecting it to get a bit better as they mentioned they are planning to renovate when I had joined in.

Now this is the most insane part -
From 0 it went to minus 5 when it comes to hygiene

Steam room is stinking,

Still no mats ( imagine 6 months prior a member complaint thrice and they can't afford to keep a towel or cloth or mats outside shower rooms or steam it's is so risky

The moment I got done with steam and went to shower rooms I was surprised to see spider webs, fleas and so many insects ( which is by the way a very small shower room ) I felt claustrophobic and stepped out.

I am surprised if some government offical or someone who looks for cleanliness steps in what will they wonder.

Honestly I don't expect gym to be perfect
But basic things which is cleanliness
Mattress or hygeine needs to be followed

The shower rooms are worst then public toilet

Horrible experience, I still have my membership left I stepped out and have joined another gym.

I know it won't matter to you , you have lost one member but understand the disappointment of service.

I hope they understand the seriousness of health being at risk for members.

featured_reviews.name: Abhay Bhonsle
featured_reviews.review_text:
MeltFit has truly changed the way I see myself. I joined because I’ve always loved CrossFit, but training here has awakened the athlete in me in a way I never imagined. Every workout pushes me mentally and physically, and over time I’ve become stronger, more disciplined, and far more confident in my abilities.

What makes this place special is the people. The trainers genuinely care about our progress and constantly motivate us to break our own limits. The dietician guidance has also played a huge role in improving my fitness and overall lifestyle.

MeltFit is not just a gym or a CrossFit studio for me anymore — it’s the place where I discovered my inner athlete. Highly recommend it to anyone who wants to transform themselves and become the strongest version of who they can be.

featured_reviews.name: Zaid Mirza
featured_reviews.review_text: I joined MeltFit in October 2025, and since then I’ve never felt this active or full of energy. The coaches are highly skilled, technically sound, and truly know their craft. They always ensure injuries are avoided and that every individual progresses steadily and safely. The atmosphere at the gym is both friendly and competitive, which really pushes you toward your goals. If you have any fitness goals and genuinely want to achieve them, this is the place to be.

featured_reviews.review_text: Really enjoying my experience at Meltfit! The sessions are fun, energetic, and keep you motivated to stay regular. The coaches are very supportive and motivating, and the overall environment makes working out enjoyable. A great place to build consistency and improve your fitness.

featured_reviews.name: Rahul Borkar

Found my people at Meltfit 💪

featured_reviews.review_text: Really loving Meltfit! Never thought I’d actually enjoy going to the gym, but this has been great. There’s new WODs to look forward to each day. featured_reviews.review_text: Incredible place to workout! The daily curated workout plans are brilliantly designed to mix strength training and functional fitness. The trainers put in a lot of effort for every member, and the positive atmosphere keeps you motivated throughout. Highly recommended!

featured_reviews.name: Vishal Kamble
featured_reviews.review_text: This is the gym/fitness centre I have been searching for long time! Trainers are putting a lot of hard work into designing daily workouts. Each day, workout sessions are fresh and exciting.I am particularly impressed by daily exercise monitoring and how trainers demonstrate each workout. They are incredibly supportive and motivating, always ready to guide and push everyone. Best of all, one hour daily sessions make it super convenient. Never feel like missing a workout for a single day.

featured_reviews.name: Mrugank Gohil
featured_reviews.review_text: Absolutely love training here! 💪 The gym has a great vibe, clean equipment, and an energetic atmosphere that keeps you motivated. Highly recommend this place to anyone serious about fitness!
